title: NetBSD and my life (2005)
summary:
In a 2005 email to the NetBSD advocacy list, Gary Rolland, a network administrator from the UK, shared his story of how NetBSD transformed his professional and personal life. Working for a large company supporting over 4,800 users on mission-critical servers, Gary and his team initially struggled with Windows, which he described as a "nightmare." Frequent crashes led to constant call-outs, causing stress and disrupting his family life, notably a planned trip to Alton Towers with his daughter that was cut short due to server failures.

Driven by frustration, Gary convinced his boss to let him trial NetBSD. After an overnight effort setting up two servers, their stability proved superior when Windows machines inevitably crashed. This success led to a gradual migration of their entire network, consisting of 29 high-end servers, to NetBSD 2.0.2. These servers now efficiently handle immense loads for MySQL, Apache, Postfix, and Samba, pushing over 870GB of data and 1,200 emails daily.

The transition to NetBSD drastically improved stability and efficiency. Gary's team, initially unfamiliar with NetBSD, learned it and developed a personal interest. Critically, Gary's personal life also benefited immensely: he was no longer constantly busy or on weekend call-outs, leading to better relationships and more time with his daughter. He concludes by thanking the NetBSD team, emphasizing that their work is deeply appreciated and has positively changed his team's lives.
chinese_title: NetBSD 和 我的生活 (2005)
chinese_summary:
2005年，在一封发给NetBSD宣传邮件列表的邮件中，来自英国的网络管理员Gary Rolland分享了NetBSD如何改变了他的职业生涯和个人生活的故事。Gary受雇于一家大型公司，负责支持关键任务服务器上的4800多名用户。最初，Gary和他的团队在使用Windows时苦苦挣扎，他将其描述为“一场噩梦”。频繁的系统崩溃导致不断被叫去处理，给他带来了压力，并扰乱了他的家庭生活，尤其是一次与女儿计划好的Alton Towers之旅，因服务器故障而被迫中断。

在挫败感的驱使下，Gary说服他的老板允许他试用NetBSD。经过一夜努力设置了两台服务器后，当Windows机器不可避免地崩溃时，NetBSD服务器的稳定性被证明更胜一筹。这一成功促使他们将由29台高端服务器组成的整个网络逐步迁移到NetBSD 2.0.2。这些服务器现在能够高效地处理MySQL、Apache、Postfix和Samba的巨大负载，每天处理超过870GB的数据和1200封电子邮件。

转向NetBSD极大地提高了系统的稳定性和效率。Gary的团队最初对NetBSD不熟悉，但他们学会了它并产生了个人兴趣。至关重要的是，Gary的个人生活也受益匪浅：他不再持续忙碌或在周末随叫随到，这使得他的人际关系更好，并有更多时间陪伴女儿。他最后感谢了NetBSD团队，强调他们的工作深受赞赏，并积极改变了他团队的生活。

title: NanoGPT Speedrun Frontier
summary:
The NanoGPT Speedrun Frontier showcases a competitive evaluation of various AI models' performance in closing the gap towards a human record of 2,600 on a specific task, from an initial baseline of 3,290. Models are ranked by the percentage of this gap they have closed.

Fable 5 emerges as the top performer, achieving a record of 2,726 and closing 81.7% of the human record gap over 8.7 days. Opus 5 follows with 53.6% of the gap closed (record 2,920), and Kimi K3 (prime-agent) at 52.2% (record 2,930). Other notable contenders include GPT-5.6 Sol, Sonnet 5, Grok 4.5, and DeepSeek V4 Pro, among others, with their records and associated "gap closed" percentages.

The leaderboard also provides detailed operational metrics for each model, such as agent time, total and output tokens, number of experiments, and calls, highlighting the diverse computational strategies and resources utilized. Many models are noted as "running" or in a "serial era," indicating ongoing development and iterative improvements. While significant progress is evident across the board, no AI model has yet fully matched or surpassed the established human record of 2,600.
chinese_title: NanoGPT 速通前沿
chinese_summary:
纳米GPT速通前沿展示了对各类AI模型性能的竞争性评估，旨在从初始基线3,290分，缩小与特定任务上人类2,600分记录的差距。模型根据其缩小的差距百分比进行排名。

Fable 5脱颖而出，表现最佳，在8.7天内取得了2,726分的记录，并缩小了81.7%的人类记录差距。Opus 5紧随其后，缩小了53.6%的差距（记录2,920分），Kimi K3 (prime-agent) 以52.2%位列第三（记录2,930分）。其他值得关注的竞争者包括GPT-5.6 Sol、Sonnet 5、Grok 4.5和DeepSeek V4 Pro等，以及它们的记录和相应的“差距缩小”百分比。

排行榜还提供了每个模型的详细运行指标，例如代理时间、总token和输出token、实验次数以及调用次数，突出了其多样化的计算策略和所利用的资源。许多模型被标记为“运行中”或处于“串行时代”，表明其正在持续开发和迭代改进中。尽管总体上取得了显著进展，但尚未有任何AI模型完全达到或超越既定的人类2,600分记录。

title: Figmimic – A bookmarklet to copy any webpage into Figma as editable layers
summary:
Figmimic is a bookmarklet that captures any live web page and copies it to your clipboard as editable Figma frames, not flat screenshots. It operates on any page, including dashboards or authenticated apps, by embedding Figma's own `capture.js` internally. This design prevents external loads from the captured page, allowing it to bypass strict Content Security Policies (CSP).

To use Figmimic, drag the provided bookmarklet to your browser's bookmarks bar (it's large, around 400KB, and should be updated periodically). Then, navigate to the desired web page, click the bookmarklet, wait for the "Copied" confirmation, and paste the editable interface directly into Figma.

Common issues include Firefox not saving the bookmarklet due to URL length limits (Chrome or Safari are recommended). If the clipboard is refused or it prompts to "click this page to capture it," a subsequent click anywhere on the page will trigger the copy, as clipboard writes require user interaction and focus. Some images might be missing if the page's `connect-src` policy restricts embedding from third-party domains; text, layout, and styles remain unaffected.
chinese_title: Figmimic – 一个将任何网页作为可编辑图层复制到 Figma 的书签工具
chinese_summary:
Figmimic是一个书签小工具，能捕获任何实时网页并将其作为可编辑的Figma画板（而非扁平截图）复制到您的剪贴板。它通过内部嵌入Figma自己的`capture.js`，适用于任何页面，包括仪表盘或已认证的应用程序。这种设计避免了从被捕获页面进行外部加载，使其能够绕过严格的内容安全策略（CSP）。

要使用Figmimic，请将提供的书签小工具拖动到您的浏览器书签栏（它很大，大约400KB，应定期更新）。然后，导航到所需的网页，点击该书签小工具，等待“已复制”确认，并将可编辑的界面直接粘贴到Figma中。

常见问题包括Firefox由于URL长度限制无法保存该书签小工具（推荐使用Chrome或Safari）。如果剪贴板被拒绝或提示“点击此页面进行捕获”，随后在页面上的任意点击都将触发复制，因为写入剪贴板需要用户交互和焦点。如果页面的`connect-src`策略限制从第三方域进行嵌入，某些图片可能会丢失；但文本、布局和样式不受影响。

title: Belgian car salesman becomes prince after DNA test proves royal parentage
summary:
Clément Vandenkerckhove, a 26-year-old Belgian car salesman, has become a prince after a DNA test confirmed his biological father is Prince Laurent, the younger brother of King Philippe. His mother, Belgian singer Wendy Van Wanten, who had a relationship with Prince Laurent in the 1990s, revealed his parentage to him when he turned 16.

Around six months ago, Vandenkerckhove was legally recognized as Prince Laurent's son at a low-key town hall ceremony after the DNA test proved their connection. This formal registration grants him equal inheritance rights to Prince Laurent’s private estate alongside his half-siblings Princess Louise, Prince Nicolas, and Prince Aymeric. However, he will not receive a royal allowance, be expected to perform official duties, or have any rights to the Belgian throne.

Vandenkerckhove, born in August 2000, recounted how he contacted Prince Laurent after his mother’s admission, leading to the DNA test and subsequent "open and honest conversations." While he could adopt the family name Saxe-Coburg, he has expressed pride in his mother's family name, Vandenkerckhove.

This event marks another instance of secret royal parentage emerging in Belgium. Prince Laurent’s father, former King Albert II, also acknowledged in 2020 that he had fathered a daughter, Delphine Boël, during an affair. After a lengthy legal battle, she was granted the title of princess and now uses the name Delphine de Saxe-Coburg.
chinese_title: DNA检测证实王室血统，比利时汽车销售员变王子
chinese_summary:
克莱门特·范登克尔克霍夫（Clément Vandenkerckhove），一名26岁的比利时汽车销售员，在DNA测试证实其生父是菲利普国王的弟弟洛朗亲王后，成为了亲王。他的母亲，比利时歌手温迪·范·万腾（Wendy Van Wanten），曾在20世纪90年代与洛朗亲王有过一段感情，在他16岁时向他揭示了身世。

大约六个月前，在DNA测试证实他们父子关系后，范登克尔克霍夫在一场低调的市政厅仪式上被合法确认为洛朗亲王的儿子。这项正式登记赋予了他与同父异母的兄弟姐妹路易丝公主、尼古拉斯亲王和艾默里克亲王对洛朗亲王私人遗产的同等继承权。然而，他不会获得王室津贴，也不需要履行官方职责，更不享有比利时王位的任何权利。

范登克尔克霍夫出生于2000年8月，他回忆道，在母亲坦白后，他联系了洛朗亲王，这促成了DNA测试以及随后的“开诚布公的对话”。尽管他可以选择采用萨克森-科堡（Saxe-Coburg）的姓氏，但他表示对自己母亲的姓氏范登克尔克霍夫感到自豪。

这一事件标志着比利时又一起王室秘密血缘关系的浮出水面。洛朗亲王的父亲，前国王阿尔贝二世，也曾在2020年承认自己在一段婚外情中育有一女，德尔菲娜·布埃尔（Delphine Boël）。经过漫长的法律斗争，她被授予了公主头衔，现在使用德尔菲娜·德·萨克森-科堡（Delphine de Saxe-Coburg）这个名字。
